text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Arriving at the pool—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Phew~... Swam and swam. Man, my body's 
beat. Guess that's enough for today...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Nature! Voluntary training, huh? 
Putting in the work!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Hishiama-san. Nah— Not at all, I was 
just paddling around a bit.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Then wanna swim together with me? Big 
sis here will whip ya into shape!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Eh... r-right now? Umm, well, I might just 
get in your way and all...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Don't be shy! I'll keep ya company until 
your limits!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... ...Wait a sec, at this hour...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Umm, before we start training, there's 
actually something I've been meaning to 
ask.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hm? What is it? Fire away with anything!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Alright! It's about foot plant technique 
during a race—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
—Do that, and you can run using every bit 
of your leg power. Right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I see~, so there's that approach too. Huh, 
that's really educational.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Hishiama-anesan and Nature! Good work 
today~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, perfect timing! ...I mean, good work 
to you too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hishiama-san, this girl has been troubled 
with her swimming form. She's been doing 
solo practice the whole time lately.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? If you'd asked me, I would've 
coached you.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Eh, really?! Then, if it's okay, maybe 
right now...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, leave it all to big sis! Alright, 
together with Nature's special training—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, no, I already got the advice I was 
looking for.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Please focus on helping her out. Well 
then, I'll be taking off for today~...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ouch, my lower back is killing me...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
What's with her, was she completely 
exhausted all along? She could've just 
said so honestly instead of beating around 
the bush.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Still, slick way of resolving it. Next 
time, I definitely won't let her get away, 
though!
